method: Euclidean distance from the declared attachment location (owning-body frame, neutral pose) to the nearest point of the Bone_Mesh_Plots Open_Sim_Bone_Geometry point cloud; pelvis points take the nearer of Pelvis_R and Sacrum. Clouds are sparse surface samples, so these distances carry cloud-spacing granularity and are used as a layer-ordering metric, not a clearance tolerance.
